Извлечение MEV

The process by which validators or miners maximize profits by reordering, including, or censoring transactions in a block to capture additional value beyond standard block rewards or fees.

Definition

The process by which validators or miners maximize profits by reordering, including, or censoring transactions in a block to capture additional value beyond standard block rewards or fees.
